_note: GM personality presets (DESIGN.md section 9). Every dial is 0..1 except difficulty (encounter size multiplier, 1 = standard). Our own data.

dials.aggression: How much the GM values attacking over staying safe.
dials.caution: How much it values cover and staying out of enemy reach; damaged units retreat sooner.
dials.focus_fire: 1 = gang up on the most hurt target, 0 = spread attacks around.
dials.reinforcements: Chance per round, after round 2, that reinforcements arrive (missions that allow them).
dials.randomness: How unpredictable choices are (noise added to every score).
dials.environments: Chance that weather or a world that suggests a rules environment (sandstorm, blizzard, low gravity...) brings that environment's rules into the mission.

Standard.description: A fair fight: enemies use cover and focus on good targets.

Ruthless.description: Enemies gang up on the weakest pilot and press every advantage.

Cautious.description: Enemies hug cover, keep their distance and pull back when hurt.

Chaotic.description: Unpredictable: wild moves, scattered attacks, surprise reinforcements.

Teaching.description: Gentle: smaller fights, spread-out attacks, and every enemy move explained.
